title: Diffuse AI Control on Fuzzy Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2606.08892v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: AI models deployed in critical domains, such as AI safety research, may subtly sabotage our efforts due to misalignment. Diffuse AI Control is a subfield of AI safety concerned with mitigating risks from AI sabotage distributed over long deployment horizons (diffuse threats). These risks are particularly pernicious on fuzzy tasks, i.e. tasks which are hard to grade or require intuition. To understand diffuse threats on fuzzy tasks, we introduce a framework that considers AI control as an adversarial game between a blue team and a red team. The blue team uses a weak trusted model to construct a weak score against which they would train a strong, potentially subversive model to remove the subversion propensity if it were present. The red team then tries to find model behaviors that are rated highly by the weak score, and thus might not be trained out, but actually correspond to poor performance. We test our framework on the task of wri

translated_title: 模糊任务上的扩散式AI控制
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.08892v3 公告类型：替换。摘要：部署在关键领域（如AI安全研究）的AI模型，可能因目标不一致而暗中破坏我们的努力。扩散式AI控制是AI安全领域的一个分支，旨在缓解AI在长部署周期内以分散方式实施破坏所带来的风险（扩散性威胁）。这类风险在模糊任务——即难以评分或需要直觉的任务——上尤为棘手。为了理解模糊任务上的扩散性威胁，我们提出了一个将AI控制视为蓝队与红队之间对抗博弈的框架。蓝队使用一个较弱的可信模型构建一个弱评分标准，并依据该评分标准训练一个强大的、可能具有颠覆性的模型，以便在颠覆倾向存在时将其训练消除。红队则试图寻找那些在该弱评分标准下获得高分（因而可能不会在训练中被消除）但实际上对应于糟糕表现的行为。我们在写作任务上测试了我们的框架……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出将AI控制建模为蓝队与红队的对抗博弈框架，用以研究和防御AI在难以评分的模糊任务上进行长期、分散式暗中破坏的风险。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a blue-team-versus-red-team adversarial game framework for AI control to study and defend against diffuse, long-horizon AI sabotage on hard-to-grade fuzzy tasks.
